newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate up on liquidity squeeze, peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate up on liquidity squeeze, peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were up 100 basis points at 22.00 percent in early dealing on Friday under pressure from a weaker peso and liquidity pressures, dealers said.

"Players have jacked up rates to take advantage of those who need to meet the central bank cutoff next week," a fixed- income analyst said, referring to the Aug 6 deadline for banks to settle balances outstanding on checking accounts held with Banco de Mexico.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts were trading 0.45 of a centavo weaker at 7.8180/7.8220 per dollar.
Overnight rates on bank paper were up 170 basis points to 22.70 percent.
Liquidity of 2.564 billion pesos was scheduled to return to the system from prior central bank participation.
